Subject: Marquette Table & Tap - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Marquette Table & Tap. I've reviewed the information and have everything needed to move forward.

However, this risk requires referral to senior underwriting due to coastal exposure concerns. With 2 locations within 16 km of the coast and our existing portfolio concentration in that area already high, it falls outside my binding authority.

I'm happy to escalate this internally, but given our current coastal accumulation limits, approval may be challenging. You might also consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market, as they may be better positioned for this exposure.

Let me know if you'd like me to submit for referral or if you'd prefer to explore other markets first.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
